extension.description: An evolution of the Project Manager with support for multiple levels, integrated Git status visualization, and fast fuzzy search.
viewsContainers.title: Project Organizer
views.projects.name: Projects
config.scanPaths.description: List of absolute directories to scan recursively for projects.
config.scanDepth.description: Maximum scanning depth starting from base paths.
config.ignoredFolders.description: Directories to ignore during automatic scanning.
config.gitStatusEnabled.description: Enable Git status monitoring (active branch and modified files).
config.gitStatusInterval.description: Interval in milliseconds to update Git status for visible projects in the tree.
config.customProjectsFile.description: Optional path to save the project list to an external JSON file (for sync between machines).
config.treeExpanded.description: Automatically expand all group folders in the sidebar tree when projects are loaded.
